game.title: Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy
game.blurb: Platformer collection remaking the first three Crash Bandicoot games, from Vicarious Visions, released 2017-06-30. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Platformer. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Crash Bandicoot: Levels and Bosses
chapters.summary: The first game's bosses, bonus rounds, Coco's spin and its hidden achievements. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Crash Bandicoot: Gems, Relics and Lives
chapters.summary: Gem paths, 13 and 26 Gems, Relics and 99 lives in the first game.

chapters.title: Cortex Strikes Back: Levels and Bosses
chapters.summary: The second game's bosses, bonus and Death Routes, Coco's leg drop and its hidden achievements. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Cortex Strikes Back: Gems, Relics and Lives

chapters.title: Warped: Levels and Bosses
chapters.summary: The third game's bosses, bonus and Death Routes, Coco's hurricane spin and its hidden achievements. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Warped: Gems, Relics and Lives
chapters.summary: Gem paths, bonus-level Gems, 21 and 42 Gems, Relics and 99 lives in the third game.

chapters.title: Extra Levels
chapters.summary: Four achievements listed last in the Steam schema: two for the first game and two for the third, including a UFO in Future Tense.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). A remake of three older games, so this uses the trilogy's own Steam app, 731490; its Steam schema names the app "CREM" (an internal codename). Achievement names start with "C1 |", "C2 |" or "C3 |", which is how they were split by game; the game names in the chapter titles come from the StrategyWiki page, which links "Crash Bandicoot", "Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back" and "Crash Bandicoot: Warped". StrategyWiki's "Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy" page is at completion stage 2 but has no subpages of its own (no Walkthrough or Table of Contents), so nothing was used. crashbandicoot.fandom.com has the page, with about 174 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 21 of 74 Steam achievements are hidden; each sits in its own game's levels-and-bosses chapter. The four "Extra Levels" achievements describe their goals only loosely ("Seek and destroy", "Do hard time"), so that chapter title is our own guess at what they cover. RAWG average playtime (4 hours) looks low for three games.
